notablePrerequisites:
Empowered Autogenerator has at least three charge counters on it.
You control a nontoken noncreature artifact with mana value less than or equal to the number of charge counters on Empowered Autogenerator minus three.
description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding at least {4}.
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate Clock of Omens by tapping the nontoken noncreature artifact and Ancestral Statue, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Resolve both Ancestral Statue triggers, returning it and the nontoken noncreature artifact to your hand.
Cast the noncreature artifact by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
